convert_json_to_flattened: convert JSON SIMMC dataset files into line-by-line stringified predict and target formats for GPT-2 DST model training
parse_flattened_result: parse a single flattened belief state string and extract dialog acts, slots, request slots, objects, and disambiguation candidates
parse_flattened_results_from_file: parse all lines from a flattened results file and return a list of parsed belief state dictionaries
represent_visual_objects: stringify visual object IDs into a multimodal context string wrapped with <SOM> and <EOM> markers
convert_json_to_flattened_with_retrieval: convert JSON SIMMC dataset with retrieval candidates into flattened predict, target, and retrieval output files
